messages:
maria: seeing thermal throttling alerts for na-west ephemeral GPU pool, multiple nodes flapping.
jihoon: yep started ~5m ago. pods are restarting with OOM-ish logs, but PCB shows heat spikes on p3s.
alex: any network symptoms or is this pure thermal/host instability?
maria: network looks fine, high driver retries and gpus going into reduced clock mode -> serving latency up ~40ms p95 -> errors for long requests.
sre-oncall: alarming CPU on relay nodes too because of retries. Can we shed traffic quickly to avoid full pool blackout?
ops-lead: propose small-rate shift (10-15%) off na-west to na-east and eu-west, keep most traffic local for affinity. we don't want a big redistribution that triggers cold starts.
jihoon: agree. let's do incremental weight changes with TTL extension to smooth clients.
alex: I can run gslb playbook. plan:
```
# start incremental shift
gslbctl set-weight na-west 85
gslbctl set-weight na-east 10
gslbctl set-weight eu-west 5
# extend TTLs to 30s to avoid oscillation
gslbctl set-ttl 30s
```
maria: +1. also decrease connection concurrency on na-west gateways to avoid queuing: set conn_limit to 80%.
sre-oncall: applying conn limit now.
gslb-bot: ACTION: weights updated by alex at 1726310100. na-west=85, na-east=10, eu-west=5. TTL=30s.
maria: monitoring logs and latency. so far p95 down from +40ms to +12ms. node thermal readings stable but still elevated.
ops-lead: cost note: shifting to na-east increases egress/instance costs ~2.3%. fine for short window.
jihoon: if temp keeps climbing, we'll prepare for staged full-evac (20 -> 0 over 10min). but for now keep gradual.
alex: rolling back small change if errors spike >0.5% or error budget crosses threshold.
sre-oncall: setting alert for error rate >0.3% sustained for 2m.
maria: one node reported NVML GPU reset but recovered. tagging for postmortem: ephemeral-pool-thermal-172630.
ops-lead: good. after we stabilize, let's run a quick infra-repro to see if OS-level power management patches needed.
jihoon: agreed. will schedule on-call repro session and notify hw vendor.
alex: final note — remember to update customer-facing routing notes if we extend shift beyond 2h.
maria: will hold thread for updates. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
